  content = '## A Fresh Spider-Man Origin\n\nYour Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man took the bold approach of reimagining Peter Parker''s origin in an alternate timeline where Norman Osborn becomes his mentor instead of Tony Stark. The result was one of the most acclaimed animated Marvel series, praised for its unique art style and faithful-yet-fresh take on classic Spider-Man stories.\n\n## Norman Osborn as Mentor\n\nColman Domingo''s Norman Osborn as a seemingly benevolent mentor to Peter Parker created delicious dramatic irony for fans who know where the Green Goblin story leads.   metaDescription = 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man (2025) guide — animated origin, Norman Osborn mentor twist, trading card values, and why this is Marvel''s best animated show.',
  keywords = 'friendly neighborhood spider-man, animated, peter parker, norman osborn, colman domingo, disney plus marvel, marvel cards',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man animated cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is this connected to Tom Holland''s Spider-Man?","answer":"No, this is set in an alternate timeline where Peter Parker''s origin unfolds differently, with Norman Osborn as his mentor instead of Tony Stark."},{"question":"Is this show good for kids?","answer":"Yes, while it deals with mature themes, it is animated and appropriate for older children and teens, similar to the tone of classic Spider-Man cartoons."}]',
  status = 'published'
